name: Fractured Universe
storyline: Taking place after the Fracture, a cataclysmic event that destroyed the multiverse, the remaining pieces of the multiverse collected together to form one singular universe. Now 300 years after its formation, the culture clash of factions from such wildly different worlds continue to put strain on the relative peace that exists. Now the dragon that the myth of the Fracture credits as its source is set to awaken and these factions may need to learn how to put aside their differences to make sure that that the dragon doesn't finish what it started.
summary: A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development. Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed. Featured various art styles and aesthetics.
